name: Repent!
source:
Sick and tired of their mortal being led astray, an angel decides to take matters into their own hands. It very quickly gets out of hand. 

[From [url=https://brittlebonepromenade.itch.io/repent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
受够了自己守护的凡人屡屡误入歧途，一名天使决定亲自出手整顿。谁知事态很快便彻底失控。

[摘自[url=https://brittlebonepromenade.itch.io/repent]itch.io[/url]]
